string-array.name: import_stratum_steps
string-array.item: Open the menu and tap Backup, then Backup to file. Choose a password and save the .stratum file. Or tap Export and choose Unencrypted (JSON) for a file without one.
Choose the saved file here. A backup opens with the password you chose.

resources.string: Categories come across as tags. A backup made by Authenticator Pro before 2022 opens too.
